messages.subject: Executive Value Proposition | Emirates NBD | Corporate Affairs, ESG & International Growth
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Sowaidan,

I am writing to share a strategic value proposition prepared specifically for Emirates NBD as the Group expands its regional footprint, deepens ESG leadership and strengthens its role as a key financial institution supporting the UAE's economic ambitions.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department, at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy and executive advisory within a capital-intensive multinational operating environment. I work across public institutions, communities, technical teams and senior management to translate external expectations into accountable execution.

Emirates NBD's current direction aligns strongly with my background. The Group has surpassed AED 1.2 trillion in assets, is accelerating international growth across Saudi Arabia, India and other core markets, and is embedding sustainability, digital transformation and governance into its operating model. My experience is most relevant where corporate affairs, government relationships, ESG commitments, international market execution and executive decision support intersect.

Rather than send a conventional CV alone, I have attached an Emirates NBD-specific strategic value brief. It identifies areas where my experience could support the Group across government and institutional relations, regional expansion readiness, ESG and sustainable finance execution, corporate reputation and executive issues management. The document also includes a 90-180 day action framework and my three-page executive CV.

I would value a confidential discussion if you see alignment within Group Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Strategy, International Banking, Government Relations or selected regional mandates.

Kind regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | AGM Inc., Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
+592 608 4735

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Proposition for Emirates NBD
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Emirates NBD is expanding from a strong UAE base into a more internationally diversified, digitally enabled and sustainability-led financial group. Its 2026 priorities include continued growth across core regional markets, integration of major international investments, deeper ESG governance, sustainable finance, AI-enabled transformation and stronger corridor-linked business. My value proposition is to strengthen the institutional layer connecting these priorities with government, regulators, strategic partners and stakeholders. As Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, I lead country-facing government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social responsibility, stakeholder strategy and executive advisory in a highly regulated multinational environment. I would bring Emirates NBD practical experience in institutional relations, cross-border stakeholder execution, ESG evidence, reputation management and executive issue coordination.
strategic_brief.company_context: Emirates NBD entered 2026 with significant momentum. In the first quarter, total assets surpassed AED 1.2 trillion, lending reached AED 703 billion and deposits rose to AED 830 billion. The Group continues to invest in its regional footprint, digital capabilities and GenAI while pursuing international expansion as a core strategic pillar. Its 2025 annual report highlights accelerating growth in Saudi Arabia, deeper investment in India and a broader presence across 13 countries. International income grew 19% in 2025, while the Group also advanced its ESG agenda through sustainable finance, climate reporting and stronger governance. By the first half of 2026, Emirates NBD had completed its acquisition of RBL Bank, strengthening its position across major trade and investment corridors. This growth model creates growing demand for coordinated corporate affairs, government relations, stakeholder intelligence and ESG execution across multiple jurisdictions.

opportunities.title: Government and Institutional Relations
opportunities.rationale: Expansion across Saudi Arabia, India and other priority markets increases the importance of structured engagement with regulators, ministries, investment bodies, business councils and strategic institutional partners. Strong relationship architecture helps leadership anticipate policy shifts, regulatory dependencies and stakeholder expectations before they affect growth plans, operating continuity or corporate reputation.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would support stakeholder mapping, executive briefing, relationship planning, commitment tracking and issue escalation across selected markets. My current role requires continuous coordination with public institutions and regulators where timing, trust and accountable follow-through directly influence business continuity and strategic outcomes.

opportunities.title: Regional Expansion Readiness
opportunities.rationale: International growth creates execution requirements beyond commercial banking strategy. New and expanding markets bring local regulatory expectations, government priorities, workforce considerations, ESG obligations and stakeholder sensitivities that need to be integrated into market plans early rather than treated as downstream issues after investment commitments are already made.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would develop a practical market-readiness framework combining regulatory pathways, government relations, ESG considerations, stakeholder analysis and executive reporting. My multinational operating experience focuses on translating external requirements into coordinated action across corporate and country teams.

opportunities.title: ESG and Sustainable Finance Evidence
opportunities.rationale: Emirates NBD has strengthened its sustainable finance position, ESG reporting and climate governance while expanding products and commitments across markets. As these initiatives scale, strong evidence, traceability and cross-functional ownership become increasingly important for credibility, assurance, investor confidence, executive oversight and regulatory readiness.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would support ESG execution by linking commitments to operating evidence, named owners, stakeholder expectations and concise management reporting. My experience includes carbon-data traceability using physical operating records and governance around a major renewable energy and battery-storage platform.

opportunities.title: Corporate Reputation and Issues
opportunities.rationale: A regional financial institution operating across multiple jurisdictions faces reputation issues connected to regulation, sustainability, market expansion, social impact and public-sector relationships. Corporate affairs is strongest when external positioning is grounded in verified facts, clear ownership, coordinated executive decisions and timely escalation across business functions.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would strengthen executive issue briefs, stakeholder-risk registers and decision support for sensitive matters. I routinely coordinate regulator-facing and reputation-sensitive issues across operations, legal, finance, HR, procurement, environment, security and senior management with emphasis on accuracy and closure.

opportunities.title: Strategic Partnerships and Corridors
opportunities.rationale: Emirates NBD's growth strategy increasingly connects the UAE with Saudi Arabia, India and other international markets through investment, trade, wealth and corporate banking corridors. Institutional partnerships with governments, investors, industry groups and major clients are central to turning these corridors into durable sources of growth and differentiation.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would support partnership strategies that connect commercial objectives with government priorities, investment agencies, industry stakeholders and institutional partners. My current work combines external affairs, strategic partnerships and cross-functional coordination around complex investment and operating priorities.

days_0_30: Confirm priority markets and workstreams where government, stakeholder or ESG support creates strongest near-term value.
Map regulators, ministries, investment bodies, strategic partners and internal owners against expansion priorities.
Review corporate affairs, ESG evidence and issue-escalation processes for gaps and decision bottlenecks.
days_31_60: Select priority pilots in markets or business units with high strategic and stakeholder complexity.
Build integrated stakeholder and market-readiness plans with objectives, owners and escalation thresholds.
Create an executive dashboard covering dependencies, commitments, emerging issues and partnership opportunities.
days_61_90: Launch pilot engagement plans with agreed executive sponsors and structured briefing materials.
Connect ESG commitments to evidence, ownership and management review across selected workstreams.
Capture repeatable practices for wider regional use.
days_91_180: Scale effective practices into a common framework for international stakeholder strategy and market readiness.
Measure impact through decision-cycle time, issue closure, stakeholder outcomes and evidence quality.
Institutionalize leadership reporting on external dependencies and reputation-sensitive matters.

potential_impact: Earlier visibility of government and regulatory dependencies across priority growth markets.
Stronger readiness for regional expansion through integrated stakeholder, ESG and institutional planning.
Higher-quality ESG evidence and accountability across selected sustainability and sustainable-finance workstreams.
More consistent executive decision support on reputation-sensitive and regulator-facing matters.
Stronger strategic partnerships across key investment and trade corridors.
background_relevance: Current Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with country-facing responsibility spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG, social responsibility, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and executive communications.
Leads senior institutional engagement across mining, environment, energy, aviation, labour, standards, taxation, trade, investment and social-performance matters.
Coordinates permits, inspections, official visits, commitments and sensitive matters across operations, HSE, environment, legal, HR, finance, procurement, security and technical teams.
Supports stakeholder governance around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.
Coordinated a 2026 carbon-accounting proof of concept using physical operating data to strengthen traceability and review readiness.
Brings 12+ years across multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, supported by an MBA and international executive-development exposure.
